title: Evaluation private company maize hybrids for grain yield
objective: To identify high yielding maize hybrids for grain yield
inference: Among two hybrids evaluated with two checks for grain yield, the hybrid CP-202 (13654 kg/ha) recorded significantly higher grain yield followed by CP-201 (12260 kg/ha) over the national check (NC) Bio-9544 (11486 kg/ha) and local check (LC) MAH 14-5 (10568 kg/ha). Further the hybrid CP-202 shown 18.9 and 29.2% superiority, while CP-201 shown 6.7 and 16.0% and superiority over NC and LC respectively.
